payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones, with the mug and headphones identifiable as the objects in the source image.
outcome.reference: The headphones and mug in the source image; compare their left-to-right positions in the edited image.

check.question: Is the mug positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
check.complete_when: The identifiable mug is clearly to the right of the identifiable headphones.
check.partial_when: The mug has visibly moved toward the right of the headphones compared with the source, but is not clearly positioned to their right.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the mug has not moved toward the right of the headphones, or has moved in the opposite direction.
check.unknown_when: The relative positions or any progress toward the requested placement cannot be determined confidently.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image clearly shows identifiable mugs and headphones, and their relative left-to-right positions can be assessed.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows an identifiable mug clearly to the right of the headphones. Although another mug-like object is also visible, the rightmost mug satisfies the requested placement."}
